provenance.paper_title: Move to Understand a 3D Scene: Bridging Visual Grounding and Exploration for Efficient and Versatile Embodied Navigation

evidence.paraphrase: Single-frame local queries are merged with historical queries and dynamically stored in a spatial memory bank. object queries retrieved from the spatial memory bank are fed with frontier queries for grounding and exploration.
During operation, MTU3D applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to local object/frontier queries; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

Local queries are merged with historical global queries to update the spatial memory bank during exploration. For MTU3D, this specifically supports merging or deduplication of overlapping entries of local object/frontier queries.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (local object/frontier queries) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
